title: docs(skills): the i18n skill names `fields.{field}.inlineTitle` and a joined report's block headings
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi98Ny4V8ebAep3LPcP3m5TDK)_

Fixes #26759

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:`skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` 的分组表补上两把 18.2 已接受、运行时已下发但技能没教的键:`fields.{field_name}` 行加 `inlineTitle`(主从字段在父表单上的内嵌子网格标题,键挂在拥有该字段的子对象下;未翻译时保留作者原文,不回退到子对象复数标签);`reports` 那句加 `reports.{report}.blocks.{block_name}.{label,description}`(联合报表各区块标题,按区块必填的 `name` 取键)。表后各给一行示例,照搬 `app-crm` / `app-showcase` 已发货的 zh-CN 包写法。手写作者页 `content/docs/ui/translations.mdx` 同补两处。eval 文件加第 8 题覆盖两把键;其 token 棘轮行先削重复再按实测钉在 1642;`@objectstack/skills` 补丁 changeset。
- 为什么改:PR #26757 把这两把键加进了协议,卡 #26759 是它欠下的 `Skills-docs:` 后续——AI 作者照技能写翻译包时,这两处标题会一直停在作者语言。
- 风险与回滚:只改技能文本、一页文档、一个 eval JSON、一行棘轮上限和一个 changeset;不动 schema、运行时或任何键。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看:`skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`(L162 字段行、L175–177 reports 句、L182–188 示例)、`skills/objectstack-i18n/evals/bundles-locales-coverage.json`(第 6 题删重复、第 8 题新增)、`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`(棘轮行 1451 → 1642,算式在注释里)。
- 两分钟验证:`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`,预期 `objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` ✓ 余量 877、`bundles-locales-coverage.json` ✓ 余量 0,总行 `81 authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings`。
- 需要你做的:批准本 PR(`skills/**` 受管面,Tier H)。

## What changes

- **`skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md`** (the group table a bundle author picks keys from):
  - the `fields.{field_name}` row names `inlineTitle` — the heading of the inline child grid a `master_detail` field draws on its parent's form; the field lives on the child object, so the key is the child's; untranslated it keeps its authored text and never falls back to the child's plural label (wording read off `FieldTranslationSchema`'s docblock, `packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts` L133–147 on `origin/main` 0ea90c7a);
  - the sentence that said `reports`, `positions` and `permissions` hold `label` + `description` by name now continues with `reports.{report}.blocks.{block_name}.{label,description}`, keyed by the block's required `name` (`JoinedReportBlockSchema.name`, `packages/spec/src/ui/report.zod.ts`; the translation slot at `translation.zod.ts` L1199);
  - one example row each, after the `os i18n extract --no-objects-only` sentence, spelled exactly as the shipped bundles spell them for `zh-CN`: `objects.crm_opportunity_line_item.fields.opportunity.inlineTitle` (`examples/app-crm/src/translations/crm.translation.ts` L99) and `reports.showcase_task_overview.blocks.open_block.label` (`examples/app-showcase/src/system/translations/index.ts` L1362). The skill's own example bundle mirrors `examples/app-todo`, which has neither a master-detail field nor a joined report, so the rows sit in a two-line fragment fence instead of being invented into the todo bundle.
- **`content/docs/ui/translations.mdx`** (the card's hand-written-twin item, named in the claim's file surface): a row for the inline child-grid heading under the field row, and the report row gains the `reports.NAME.blocks.BLOCK.label` / `description` spelling. Not governed; it rides this PR because the claim's surface names it and the card thread has one PR.
- **`skills/objectstack-i18n/evals/bundles-locales-coverage.json`**: case 8 asks for the `Products` grid heading on the `crm_opportunity` form and the `Open Tasks` block of the joined `showcase_task_overview` report, and expects the two keys above; `must_contain` `inlineTitle` / `crm_opportunity_line_item` / `blocks` / `open_block`, `must_not_contain` `fields.opportunity_line_item` (the key on the parent) and `components.open_block` (a page-component spelling). Paid down first: case 6's `os i18n extract --no-objects-only` sentence and its `--no-objects-only` assertion duplicated case 5's pin of the same flag and were cut (77 bytes). Every name in the prompt and assertions is a shipped example's or the Zod source's; none is invented.
- **`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`**: the eval row 1451 → 1642, pinned AT the measurement with the arithmetic and the standing ruling quoted verbatim beside the sibling row: 「A:先削重复,余额按实测提高」. The `SKILL.md` row does not move (5456 of 6333).
- **Changeset** `.changeset/26759-i18n-skill-inline-title-report-blocks.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch, both declaration lines at line start.
- `packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.ts` (round 2, claim amendment 6449881440 — the card's "Stale header line" item): the Reports header comment now lists `blocks.<block_name>.label` / `.description`, keyed by the block's `name`, among a report's leaf keys. Comment only; the validator reads the Zod shape.

**Skills readings** (`skills/**` touched; before = `origin/main` 0ea90c7a, after = head; tokens = the ratchet's `ceil(bytes/4)`, stamp line excluded):

| Reading | Before | After |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `skills/objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` lines / tokens | 512 / 5282 (ceiling 6333, headroom 1051) | 520 / 5456 (ceiling 6333, headroom 877) |
| `skills/objectstack-i18n/evals/bundles-locales-coverage.json` lines / tokens | 75 / 1451 (ceiling 1451, headroom 0) | 85 / 1642 (ceiling 1642, headroom 0) |
| all `SKILL.md` lines / tokens (whole package) | 4603 / 56079 | 4611 / 56253 |

## Why

An AI author who writes a translation bundle from this skill picks keys off the group table; the two keys PR #26757 added were missing from it, so a localized app kept a master-detail grid's heading and a joined report's block headings in English even though the runtime serves both translated (the business case on the card).

## Tests

- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` at head: `81 authored bundle file(s) within their ceilings; 10 generator-owned file(s) measured, not ratcheted`, exit 0; `objectstack-i18n/SKILL.md` ✓ (5456 / 6333), `bundles-locales-coverage.json` ✓ (1642 / 1642, headroom 0).
- `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs --self-test`: `79 cases pass`, exit 0.
- The eval file parses, and no case has a `must_contain` string in its `must_not_contain`.
- No test file edited; no forced test edit.

## Acceptance notes

- The eval is not run by any gate (the repo has no eval runner; `check:skill-docs` / `check:skill-refs` / `check:skill-examples` read `SKILL.md`, `references/` and the marked code fences). The new example fence is a fragment and carries no `os:check` marker on purpose.

## Verification

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`: MANDATORY — `skills/**`, clause ①, no one-line exit; changed lines 51 vs the 3000 threshold.
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at head `4f490d8e` (the final commit) derived 87 commands. All 87 ran in the worktree after that commit, each exit code captured before any pipe: 87 of 87 exit 0 (70 source-reading commands in one serial runner, the 17 dist-reading ones in a second after the build) — among them `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` and its `--self-test`, `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec run check:skill-docs` / `check:skill-examples` / `check:docs`, `pnpm check:pm-governed-merges`, `pnpm check:pm-dispatch-gates`, `pnpm check:published-files`, `node scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs --base origin/main`, `node scripts/check-adr-0087-registration.mjs --base origin/main`, `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main`, `pnpm check:skill-identifier-liveness`, `pnpm check:skill-frame-sync`, `pnpm check:skill-compatibility`, `pnpm check:doc-authoring`, `pnpm check:docs-spec-enumerations`, `pnpm check:ratchet-remedy-authority`, `pnpm check:nul-bytes`.
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: `87 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 87 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 87 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3)`, exit 0; no UNRUN family named on stderr.
- Build closure before the dist-reading gates: `turbo run build --filter='./packages/**' --concurrency=2` under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`, `VERDICT command-exit 0` (held 8m20s).
- The edited gate script's own test suite is its `--self-test` (79 cases); no package source is touched, so no package `test` / `typecheck` is owed; `pnpm lint` is CI's run.

## Human Minimum

- [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (No schema touched.)
- [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind.
- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes (the repo-wide run is CI's; no source file edited).
- [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request.
- [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: n/a, not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English.
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
